jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

jobs.title: Bid Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. This is a process and project coordination role rather than a content or strategy role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management.

Responsibilities: 

  • Bid Planning and Scheduling Support
    • Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. 
    • Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit.
    • Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early.
  • Tracking, Follow-Up, and Accountability

Als General Manager Deutschland übernimmst du die operative Verantwortung für dieses Geschäft und reportest direkt an Sebastian, unseren COO. Gemeinsam mit ihm und Gavin, unserem CEO & Gründer, entwickelst und veränderst du das Deutschlandgeschäft und führst dafür vier Heads (Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment & Customer Retention sowie Business Development) mit einem Team von rund 25–30 Menschen, fest angestellt und freiberuflich. Du hinterfragst, was heute läuft, machst es mit den Heads besser und siehst an den Zahlen, ob es wirkt. Deine Aufgaben Führen: Du führst unsere Heads, setzt klare Prioritäten, hinterfragst den Status quo und gibst ehrliches Feedback zu den Themen. Steuern über Zahlen: Du behältst KPIs, Tracking und Cashflow im Blick, erkennst Ursachen hinter den Zahlen, misst die Wirkung jeder Initiative und leitest daraus konkrete Action-Pläne ab. Vision übersetzen: Du trägst Vision und Mission ins Team, leitest Business-Initiativen ab und weißt, welche operativen Hebel du aktivieren musst, um die Unternehmensziele voranzutreiben. Weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst den deutschsprachigen Markt weiter und sorgst dafür, dass neue Angebote wie Retreats oder Events vor Ort von unserer Zielgruppe angenommen wird. Hinterfragen und verbessern: Du prüfst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Verbes

jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & PR
jobs.description_text: Wir machen Content. Für andere. Für uns selbst kommen wir viel zu selten dazu. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere eigene Außenwirkung in die Hand nimmt: Social-Kanäle, Pressearbeit, Website, Newsletter und so weiter! Das heißt nicht Kaffee holen und Listen pflegen, sondern: Du bist die Person, durch die die Branche mitbekommt, was wir eigentlich alles bauen. Awards, Cases, Launches, Team-News, Festival-Auftritte. Wir haben viel zu erzählen und erzählen es gerade viel zu leise. Du musst nichts davon schon perfekt können. Wir brauchen jemanden, der schreiben kann, der mitdenkt und der Dinge zu Ende bringt. Den Rest zeigen wir dir. Aufgaben Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst: Unsere Social-Kanäle: Du planst, textest und veröffentlichst unsere eigenen Postings – Cases, Behind the Scenes, Team, Awards. LinkedIn ist unsere wichtigste Bühne. Dort findet unsere Branche statt: Kunden,Partner, potenzielle Kolleg:innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass dort regelmäßig etwas passiert, was nicht nach Unternehmensmeldung klingt. Instagram läuft parallel. Award-Einreichungen: Du bereitest Cases für Awards und Festivals auf. Daten sammeln, Texte bauen, Fristen im Blick behalten. Location: Berlin, Barcelona or London!

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Our strategy focuses on becoming the preferred marketplace, fleet, and operational partner for the world's best Autonomous Vehicle (AV) providers. As AV services begin launching across Europe, the programs that govern our partnerships, from pre-launch planning through ongoing operations, become a critical foundation for sustainable growth. This role sits at the center of that work, owning the end-to-end management of our autonomous partnership programs and serving as the primary face of Lyft to our external partners.

You have experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with external partners or customers. You are a skilled communicator who can represent Lyft externally with credibility and care, while bringing together a wide range of internal teams. jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description_text: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.
